required.name: title
required.label: Headline
required.why: The agent cites the piece by name, and a headline lifted from the wrong heading gets attributed wrongly.

required.name: author
required.label: Author
required.why: Attribution is how the agent tells the user whose claim this is, which is most of what it is judging.

required.name: published
required.label: Published date
required.why: Lets the agent say how old the claim is, and rank it against a fresher source on the same question.

recommended.name: updated
recommended.label: Last updated
recommended.why: Tells the agent whether a piece it read months ago has changed enough to be worth refetching.

recommended.name: section
recommended.label: Section
recommended.why: Places the piece in the publication so the agent can tell reporting from opinion from a press release.

recommended.name: description
recommended.label: Summary
recommended.why: Gives the agent the author's own summary to quote instead of compressing the body itself.
